answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with stake-weighted voting: every identity must lock scarce jade as collateral before its vote counts. A public atlas maps each bonded identity to one key, and new entries pass through a single gated inlet that charges a non-refundable fee. To forge N votes an attacker must post N independent bonds, so cost grows linearly with identities; dishonest votes get slashed, making each fake account a net loss.
